dialogues.jp: 「まだ、分からないんです……」
dialogues.en: "I don't know yet..."
dialogues.text: "I don't know yet..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.en: "What!?"
dialogues.text: "What!?"

dialogues.jp:
もの凄い勢いで、身体を乗り出してくる。思わ
ず、のけ反るようにソファーに背中を押しつけ
た。
dialogues.en: Koyomi cried out in a loud voice, leaning forward.
dialogues.text: Koyomi cried out in a loud voice, leaning forward.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「何よ、分かんないって！？　朝倉、あんたま
　さか、ことりを｛もてあそ／弄｝んで……」
dialogues.en:
"What do you mean, you don't know!? If you're thinking of
tricking Kotori, you..."
dialogues.text:
"What do you mean, you don't know!? If you're thinking of
tricking Kotori, you..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ま、待って下さいよっ！」
dialogues.en: "P, please, wait a second!"
dialogues.text: "P, please, wait a second!"

dialogues.jp:
まさに、噛みつきそうな勢いの暦先生に、両手
を挙げて押しとどめる。
dialogues.en: Koyomi was snarling, her two hands raised.
dialogues.text: Koyomi was snarling, her two hands raised.

dialogues.jp:
「だ、だからですねえ……まだ、そこまで気持
　ちが固まってないんですよ。弄ぶとか何とか
　じゃなくて」
dialogues.en:
"I, I'm not trying to trick her... I just don't know whether
my feelings for her are certain."
dialogues.text:
"I, I'm not trying to trick her... I just don't know whether
my feelings for her are certain."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「たぶん、好きなんだろうとは思います」
dialogues.en: "Probably, I really do like her."
dialogues.text: "Probably, I really do like her."

dialogues.jp:
だからこそ、工藤とことりとが、あんなに仲が
良さそうなのを見て、胸が痛んだんだと思う。
dialogues.en:
That's why when Kudou and Kotori were talking like they were
so close, that pain I felt-- this must've been the cause.
dialogues.text:
That's why when Kudou and Kotori were talking like they were
so close, that pain I felt-- this must've been the cause.

dialogues.jp:
「でも……正直、こんな気持ち初めてで、自分
　でも……」
dialogues.en:
"But... this is the first time I've ever felt this way...
so..."
dialogues.text:
"But... this is the first time I've ever felt this way...
so..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「そう……か」

気が抜けたように呟いて、とさりと、ソファー
に腰を下ろした。
dialogues.en:
Calming down and muttering to herself, she leaned back onto
the sofa.
dialogues.text:
Calming down and muttering to herself, she leaned back onto
the sofa.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「……うん、なるほど……」
dialogues.en: "...Mm, I see now..."
dialogues.text: "...Mm, I see now..."

dialogues.jp: テーブルのカップを掴み、がぶりと中身を飲む。
dialogues.en: She took the cup from the table and took a gulp of coffee.
dialogues.text: She took the cup from the table and took a gulp of coffee.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、心の中なんて、もしかしたら、自分が
　一番分からないのかもしれないね……」
dialogues.en:
"Well, it's always hard to confirm for yourself whether you
really like someone..."
dialogues.text:
"Well, it's always hard to confirm for yourself whether you
really like someone..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「もちろん、そんなの、他人だって分からない
　のかもしれないけど……」
dialogues.en:
"Especially since there's no easy way to tell whether the
other person shares your feelings..."
dialogues.text:
"Especially since there's no easy way to tell whether the
other person shares your feelings..."

dialogues.jp:
あたかも、心の底を覗き込むように、カップの
底に目を向けて、暦先生は独白した。
dialogues.en:
I felt as if she was peering into my heart, as she continued
her monologue.
dialogues.text:
I felt as if she was peering into my heart, as she continued
her monologue.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉」
dialogues.en: "Asakura."
dialogues.text: "Asakura."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes?"
dialogues.text: "Yes?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「自分でも分からない気持ち、知りたい？」
dialogues.en:
"Do you want to understand the feelings that you can't
understand right now?"
dialogues.text:
"Do you want to understand the feelings that you can't
understand right now?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉が、ことりを好きなのかどうか、その気
　持ちを」
dialogues.en: "The feelings that you have for Kotori."
dialogues.text: "The feelings that you have for Kotori."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「は、はあ、そりゃ、知りたいですけど……」
dialogues.en: "A, ah, I would like to, but..."
dialogues.text: "A, ah, I would like to, but..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「よし、朝倉、それだったら──」
dialogues.en: "Okay Asakura, in that case--"
dialogues.text: "Okay Asakura, in that case--"

dialogues.jp:
たん、とカップをテーブルに置くと、暦先生は
ずずいっと身を乗り出した。
dialogues.en: Placing her cup on the table, she leaned forward once again.
dialogues.text: Placing her cup on the table, she leaned forward once again.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「明日から、ことりの看病をしなさい」
dialogues.en: "Tomorrow, please look after Kotori."
dialogues.text: "Tomorrow, please look after Kotori."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.en: "Haah...?"
dialogues.text: "Haah...?"

dialogues.jp:
コーヒーを吹き出しそうになるのを、何とか堪
えた。
dialogues.en: I was blowing at my coffee as she proclaimed that.
dialogues.text: I was blowing at my coffee as she proclaimed that.

dialogues.jp: 「な、何でです？」
dialogues.en: "W, what do you mean?"
dialogues.text: "W, what do you mean?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「そのつき合いを通じて、朝倉の気持ちが固ま
　るかもしれないじゃない」
dialogues.en:
"The more you meet with her and talk to her, the sooner you
can understand your feelings, right?"
dialogues.text:
"The more you meet with her and talk to her, the sooner you
can understand your feelings, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「それに、現実問題、あたしもそうそう休む訳
　にはいかないからね。両親も仕事があるし」
dialogues.en:
"And besides, there's a real problem here. I can't take so
many days off work, and our parents are both working as
well."
dialogues.text:
"And besides, there's a real problem here. I can't take so
many days off work, and our parents are both working as
well."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「体調の悪い妹を、一人家に置いておくのも、
　ほんとは心苦しいのよ。その点、朝倉が居て
　くれれば安心だ」
dialogues.en:
"I don't want to leave her alone right now, especially when
she's so feeble. If you're around, I'd feel a lot better."
dialogues.text:
"I don't want to leave her alone right now, especially when
she's so feeble. If you're around, I'd feel a lot better."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ま、それに君なら、見境なくすって事もなさ
　そうだし」
dialogues.en:
"That is, as long as you do care about not leaving her alone
as well."
dialogues.text:
"That is, as long as you do care about not leaving her alone
as well."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「そ、そんなの当たり前じゃないですか！」
dialogues.en: "O, of course I do!"
dialogues.text: "O, of course I do!"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、決まりでいいね？」
dialogues.en: "Then it's decided, no?"
dialogues.text: "Then it's decided, no?"

dialogues.jp:
にっと笑う。その唇の角度に、つり込まれるよ
うにうなずいてしまった。
dialogues.en: A wolfish grin. I couldn't say anything in response.
dialogues.text: A wolfish grin. I couldn't say anything in response.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「偉い。それでこそ、朝倉だ」
dialogues.en: "Excellent, Asakura."
dialogues.text: "Excellent, Asakura."

dialogues.jp: 何の事やら。
dialogues.en: What's going on?
dialogues.text: What's going on?

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「それじゃ、その旨ことりに伝えておくから。
　嫌そうだったら、あたしから電話する」
dialogues.en:
"Anyway, I'd call you later to tell you when to come. Kotori
doesn't like to use the telephone."
dialogues.text:
"Anyway, I'd call you later to tell you when to come. Kotori
doesn't like to use the telephone."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.en: "Haah..."
dialogues.text: "Haah..."

dialogues.jp:
いつものように、練習を見るために家を出たの
に、ことりを看病する事になるなんて……。
dialogues.en:
It's not that I'd rather go to practice than to look after
Kotori while she's sick.
dialogues.text:
It's not that I'd rather go to practice than to look after
Kotori while she's sick.

dialogues.jp:
何か、いつもの電車に乗ったはずが、まるで別
の場所に運ばれてしまったような気分だった。
dialogues.en: But it is an awfully long trip by train both ways...
dialogues.text: But it is an awfully long trip by train both ways...

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ほら、そしたら、帰った帰った。あたしも何
　かと忙しいんだから」
dialogues.en:
"Both ways, hurry up and go back already. I have things to
do."
dialogues.text:
"Both ways, hurry up and go back already. I have things to
do."

dialogues.jp:
追い立てるような言葉に、俺は慌ててカップを
傾けた。
dialogues.en:
Being chased out of the house, I confusedly returned her
cup.
dialogues.text:
Being chased out of the house, I confusedly returned her
cup.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、朝倉」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, Asakura."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, Asakura."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yeah?"
dialogues.text: "Yeah?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「あたしはね、ことりの事が本当に好きなんだ。
　ほんとに、大事に思ってる」
dialogues.en: "I really love Kotori. She's an important person to me."
dialogues.text: "I really love Kotori. She's an important person to me."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「だから、泣かせるような真似したら、承知し
　ないよ」
dialogues.en:
"So don't think I'd accept it easily if you ever make her
cry."
dialogues.text:
"So don't think I'd accept it easily if you ever make her
cry."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「肝に銘じておきます」
dialogues.en: "My life is in your hands."
dialogues.text: "My life is in your hands."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ん。いい答えだ。……授業もそれくらい出来
　ればねぇ」
dialogues.en:
"Mm, good answer... at least you remember something from
your lessons."
dialogues.text:
"Mm, good answer... at least you remember something from
your lessons."

dialogues.jp:
普段のような軽口に、俺はホッと全身の緊張を
解いた。
dialogues.en:
Returning to her usual talkative self, all the tension in my
body was released somehow.
dialogues.text:
Returning to her usual talkative self, all the tension in my
body was released somehow.

dialogues.jp: 「それじゃ、失礼します」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, I'd take my leave now."
dialogues.text: "Anyway, I'd take my leave now."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「気をつけてな」
dialogues.en: "Be careful."
dialogues.text: "Be careful."

dialogues.jp: 頭を下げ、俺はその場を後にした。
dialogues.en:
Bowing my head, I prepare to return to this place in the
future.
dialogues.text:
Bowing my head, I prepare to return to this place in the
future.

dialogues.jp: ◆まだ分からない……◆
dialogues.en: ◆I Still Don't Know...◆
dialogues.text: ◆I Still Don't Know...◆

dialogues.jp:
まだ分からない、なんて答えると、暦先生から
凄い剣幕で詰め寄られてしまった。
dialogues.en:
I still don't know. Once I said that though, Koyomi-sensei
immedately took on a threatening attitude.
dialogues.text:
I still don't know. Once I said that though, Koyomi-sensei
immedately took on a threatening attitude.

dialogues.jp:
｛もてあそ／弄｝ぶとかそういうのではなくて、俺としても、
自分の気持ちが掴みがたいだけなのだ。
dialogues.en:
She had the impression that I was just trying to trick
Kotori, but I just wanted to make sure of my feelings before
I could say so to myself honestly.
dialogues.text:
She had the impression that I was just trying to trick
Kotori, but I just wanted to make sure of my feelings before
I could say so to myself honestly.

dialogues.jp:
そんな俺に対して、暦先生は一つの提案をして
きた。
dialogues.en: To help me with that, Koyomi-sensei gave me a proposal.
dialogues.text: To help me with that, Koyomi-sensei gave me a proposal.

dialogues.jp:
ことりの看病をして、気持ちを確かめろ、とい
うのだ。
dialogues.en: Look after Kotori tomorrow, and help confirm my feelings.
dialogues.text: Look after Kotori tomorrow, and help confirm my feelings.
